judgments.supporting_quote: Pipes are to be protected from mechanical damage where necessary.
Adjust the packing gland until there is a slight leakage from the stuffing box.
The data communication network is to be continuously monitored to detect failures on the communication network itself and data communication failure on nodes connected to the network.
Piping and other components are to have as few joints as practicable.
Bilges in machinery spaces are to be provided with a high level alarm in such a way that the accumulation of liquids is detected at normal angles of trim and heel.
Fit the intermediate cover (0110), the mechanical seal (1220) and the impeller (0120).
Pipes are generally to be delivered from the manufacturer with the protective coating applied, with on-site application limited to that necessary for installation purposes (i.e., joints).
Deterioration of grease or lubricant contaminated --- CELL --- Remove old grease, wash bearings thoroughly in kerosene and replace with new grease.
